gga_c_pbe:exc:pol.note: Overturns the pre-2026-08-31 rejection. Those numbers were taken when pow_1_3 was powers.rs::cbrt_f64, inline branch-free arithmetic LLVM packed 8-wide. rmath::cbrt (BitExact, bit-identical to glibc on 100% of 2M physical inputs) is an opaque ~9.6 ns/elem call, which stops the grid loop vectorising; explicit SIMD gives it back. Timed jointly with the vxc case (exc has no separate xcvs leg).
